subject: Recap & next step: propose rotating deep-dive cadence
messages:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
To: Sasha Lee <sasha.lee@acmeretail.com>, Tom Greene <tom.greene@acmeretail.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 30 May 2026 16:22:00 -0700
Subject: Recap & next step: propose rotating deep-dive cadence

Hi Sasha / Tom —

Great to connect earlier. Quick recap from our discovery and a concrete proposal to get the technical deep-dive scheduled with the right folks:

What we heard from you
- Primary goal: prototype inference with Redwood for search ranking (low-latency, cost-sensitive).
- Data residency: production traffic will stay in your EU tenancy; staging can be US. Need to validate KMS/HSM options.
- Success criteria: sub-150ms p95 for 1k qps bursts and evaluation set parity vs. current model.

Suggested next step
We recommend a 60-minute technical deep-dive (architecture + shot at a short demo of a representative query set). To make this workable across your teams in US/EU/APAC, I suggest a rotating weekly cadence so the burden of late/early calls is shared. Proposed slots (local times shown):

- Slot A (APAC-focused): Tue 09:00 SGT / Mon 18:00 PDT / Tue 01:00 BST
- Slot B (EMEA-focused): Wed 10:30 BST / Wed 17:30 SGT / Wed 03:30 PDT
- Slot C (Americas-focused): Thu 11:00 PDT / Thu 19:00 BST / Fri 02:00 SGT

Plan: run a 4-week rotation (Week 1 -> Slot A, Week 2 -> Slot B, Week 3 -> Slot C, Week 4 -> fallback/overflow or test slot). This keeps the same meeting time labeled in the invite but rotates the region that gets the friendly local time.

Please reply with: (1) which of the three slots you prefer for the first session, (2) names/emails of technical attendees (we'll add Redwood engineers), and (3) any hard constraints we should avoid.

Attachments: I attached a draft mutual action plan and an initial requirements workbook so we can pre-align on scope.

Thanks — happy to send a calendar series once you pick the first slot.

Connor O'Brien
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123
Redwood Inference

Connor — thanks for the clear recap. Helpful.

A few quick notes from our side:
- APAC team prefers Slot A or Slot B (Slot A best) since our ML owners are in Singapore.
- We'll want a 60-minute session: 30m architecture + 20m demo + 10m Q&A.
- Please include someone who can speak to quantization/latency tradeoffs and an infra engineer who can review KV cache and routing.
- Data residency: production must remain in EU. Can you confirm if Redwood has a EU-only rollback path and KMS integrations? (If you can pre-send a short note for our GRC folks that would speed things up.)

Attendees I plan to bring:
- Sasha Lee — Head of Search, Acme Retail
- Tom Greene — Lead Data Engineer, Acme Retail
- Priya Nair — ML Platform, Acme Retail (cc'd)

If Slot A on Tue works for Redwood, let's lock that for week 1. Otherwise propose the next best option.

Thanks,
Sasha
